biome_based_crops.guide.title: Biomes Notebook
biome_based_crops.guide.scroll_materials: U rog si aad u hesho agab badan.
biome_based_crops.guide.setup_text: Marka qolku gaadho heer kulka loo baahan yahay oo uu buuxiyo shuruudaha sagxadda dhulka iyo gudaha, waxa uu isu diiwaangelin doonaa sidii biome-kaas, taas oo awood u siinaysa mooryaan iyo makhluuqa kale in ay sidoo kale ku dhalaan. Dalagyada iyo saplings waxay u baahan yihiin muraayado cirfiid ah oo si toos ah uga sarreeya geed kasta. Inta kale ee saqafka waxay noqon kartaa mid adag. Diiwaangelinta biome waxay u baahan tahay koronto ama Tough As Nails heerkulbeeye u soo jeeda qolka. Cimiladu waxay u baahan tahay hal qaboojiye 256dii baloog ee gudaha ah. Qaybaha hawada daciifka ah ayaa tilmaamaya fur-furan. Xidh iyaga hal daqiiqo gudaheed, ka hor intaanay cimiladu ku soo laaban xaaladdeedii dabiiciga ahayd.
biome_based_crops.ac.selector_usage: Guji si aad horay u wado baaskiilka. Qabo Shift ama isticmaal furaha fallaadha bidix si aad gadaal ugu wareegtid.
biome_based_crops.greenhouse.status.miss: Ku rakib heerkulbeeye koronto ama Tough As Nails si aad u diiwaan geliso bayoolajiga aqalka dhirta lagu koriyo.
